finding: Attaching a Lua self table is not a call graph but a virtual slot. The root entity vtable 00CE6290 carries 00928A00 at slot 39 (+9Ch), 00928C80 at slot 32 (+80h) and 00928F50 at slot 11 (+2Ch). 0077E830 is an override of slot 39 that calls the base 00928A00 first and then reads the ResourceUsage property; the nine functions that call 0077E830 are themselves slot-39 overrides in derived classes, so all nine reach 00928A00 unconditionally. Forty-three vtables install a slot-39 attach: 1 base, 17 that take 0077E830 unchanged, and 25 belonging to the nine overrides. Twenty-one of the classes are named from the image through docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md. The unread kind-3 branch is a skip, not an alternative path: when entity+C0h is non-null and its kind is 3 the stale-slot clear, the fresh-table assign, ID and Dead are all jumped over at 00928AB8 and only Ptr is rebound, so a script-owned entity keeps the Lua object it already has and has its light userdata refreshed. 00928C80 is the on-killed half of the same contract: under the entity lock it sets Ptr to lightuserdata(0) and writes LastPosition = {x,y,z}; it never sets Dead. 00928F50 mirrors the entity's Race and Party integers into the same self object after the base 00923B80 has written them.

kind_three_branch.test: 00928AA4 MOV EAX,[EDI+0xC0]; 00928AAC CMP EAX,EBP; 00928AB2 JZ 00928ABE; 00928AB4 CMP dword ptr [EAX+0x4],0x3; 00928AB8 JZ 00928BEE
kind_three_branch.effect: a skip, not an alternative path: the target 00928BEE is the start of the Ptr sequence, so the nil test, the stale-slot clear, the fresh-table assign, ID and Dead are all bypassed and only Ptr is rebound
kind_three_branch.consequence: a script-owned entity keeps whatever Lua object it already has across re-attach, and its ID and Dead are whatever a previous pass or a script left; the key at entity+178h is still refreshed, because 00928A2F..00928A6A run before the test

corrections.is: 00928A00 is virtual slot 39 (+9Ch) of the root entity vtable 00CE6290 and is called indirectly through it; 0077E830 is a derived override of the same slot that calls the base directly at 0077E834
corrections.evidence: the dword at 00CE6290+9Ch is 00928A00; 43 vtables install a slot-39 attach

corrections.was: the 00928AB4 branch of 00928A00 (entity->[C0] with kind 3) was not read, so what a script entity that already owns a Lua object does instead is unknown
corrections.is: kind 3 jumps to 00928BEE and therefore does nothing instead: it skips the reset and keeps the existing table, rebinding only Ptr
corrections.evidence: 00928AB8 JZ 0x00928BEE and 00928BEE is inside the Ptr sequence that the fall-through also reaches

corrections.was: which entity kinds 0077E830 reaches 00928A00 for was not established; only that it is the sole caller
corrections.is: all nine callers of 0077E830 are slot-39 overrides that call it unconditionally as their first or near-first act, and 0077E834 calls 00928A00 unconditionally, so every one of the 25 classes behind them reaches the base attach
corrections.evidence: the nine call sites are UNCONDITIONAL_CALL xrefs and 0077E834 is the first call of 0077E830
